label: sec:spectral-sequence-chirality-confinement-per-nucleon-shift-preamble
html: When a single nucleon strand is adjoined to an A-nucleon braid via the inclusion H_A(q) \hookrightarrow H_{A+1}(q), the Gröbner–Shirshov normal form increments by a bounded Coset representative. This section proves the additive linearity of the per-nucleon shift across the spectral sequence, states strong duality for the finite-dimensional LP as a hypothesis, and proves that Frobenius self-duality on transpose partitions \lambda \leftrightarrow \lambda' pairs conjugate bound-state channels while the exterior-square Borromean representation enforces three-strand colour confinement.
